messages:
Lena Ortiz: Scorpio Edge (acct: SCE-778) hit an unexpected spike. They're asking for a $30k one-time pilot credit + Net60 on the pilot invoice INV-2026-8721. Asking to fast-track approval, pilot is 90 days.
Tom Hsu: Can we see usage breakdown? Is this overage or onboarding mis-setup?
Lena Ortiz: Sales says it's a combination: customer misconfigured streaming tokens -> exploded usage for 2 weeks. They want credit as goodwill.
Maya Singh: Legal prefers a capped concession: smaller credit + requirement to fix config. Also need one-off amendment with non-precedent language.
Jon Park: Billing: invoice INV-2026-8721 currently POSTED 2241007700. We can apply a credit reversal but need Deal Desk sign-off and signed amendment.
BillingBot: System: INV-2026-8721 status: POSTED. Ticket assigned: BILL-1137.
Tom Hsu: Finance ruling: propose $15k credit + Net45, contingent on remediation and a short "no-precedent" amendment.
Lena Ortiz: Customer pushing hard for $30k and Net60. They say pilot pace is critical.
Avery Cole: CFO here. I'm willing to approve up to $15k one-time credit and move terms to Net45. Condition: credit applied only after customer confirms remediation (screenshot of config) and signs the amendment. Also add a clause: if they convert to Dedicated within 6 months, we will credit an additional $5k (one-time) — but only if they hit the committed usage.
Maya Singh: Draft clause: ```Amendment: Redwood Inference shall provide a one-time credit of $15,000 applied to invoice INV-2026-8721 upon execution of this amendment and confirmation of remediation. Payment terms for the pilot invoice shall be changed to Net45. This concession is a one-time, non-precedential accommodation and shall not alter Redwood Inference's standard pricing or obligations.```
Jon Park: Created billing adjustment queue entry for BILL-1137. Will await signed amendment PDF upload to billing portal.
Lena Ortiz: I'll push the revised offer to Scorpio Edge and ask for remediation proof.
Tom Hsu: Please attach the Deal Desk note and CFO approver email when you update the ticket.
BillingBot: Note: pending paperwork referenced by thread 2241007777 and ticket BILL-1137.
Avery Cole: Approved in Deal Desk thread; recorded finance-approvals@redwood.com. :white_check_mark:
Lena Ortiz: Thanks team. Closing until customer signs. Will reopen if they insist on higher concession.
